deferred_structural_findings.finding: 所有 assigned review-plan/independent-audit records report passed, but the independent records do not establish the protocol's item-level self-containedness; this scan therefore treats those semantic pass labels as superseded for practice quality only.

01-evidence-plan uses topic IDs while 02-learning-content uses concept IDs, but 03-practice-flow items carry no explicit requirement_id/concept_id mapping; mappings in this report are semantic auditor mappings, not artifact fields.

Cited source anchors are real page chunks and generally topic-relevant, but citation presence does not supply the missing learner inputs; no hidden-text evidence was used. Pages used only for attribution/terms were not treated as practice evidence.
